chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 494: The Seven Charts Seal the Heavens – Final Farewell
chapter_meta_description: Xing Tian and Chiyou dominate the celestial battle, but the seven magic charts seal the Primordial Ancient Village. The Ancestral Gods send chosen cultivators away as seeds before the final stand.
og_title: WIM 494: The Ancestral Gods' Last Order – Seeds of Hope
og_description: The Otherworld deploys seven magic charts over the ancient village, blocking the path to the Primordial Celestial Realm. The Ancestral Gods prepare to send chosen warriors away as the last hope.
twitter_title: World of Immortality 494 – The Seven Magic Charts Seal All Hope
twitter_description: Ch. 494: The battle rages, but the seven charts seal the heavens. The Ancestral Gods select seeds to send away, and the final stand begins.
